rationale: Names the form for the impact assessment.

rationale: States when the QA Head reviews the trend.

span_text: Where 3 CAPAs share the same root cause within 12 months, the QA Head reviews the trend and decides whether the cause has been treated at the right level.

rationale: States the daily 100 g check tolerance.

rationale: Full calibration tolerance on the same weight.

rationale: Training note repeats the daily check tolerance.

rationale: States the current receipt confirmation time.

rationale: States the current trend rule.

rationale: Prohibits returning a read plate to the incubator.

rationale: Training note gives the same rule.

rationale: States the time allowed for second-person review after the final read.
span_text: A second person reviews the completed record within 2 working days of the final plate read, checking location codes, exposure times, plate lots, the incubator used and the arithmetic of any conversions.

rationale: States when stock is moved to the standby cold room.

span_text: If the excursion lasts more than 30 minutes, move the stock in CR-1 to CR-2 within 2 hours, with the transfer logged on FRM-WH-405.

rationale: Limits what happens after the transfer.
span_text: The stock is not released from CR-2 back into general use until QA has reviewed the trace and decided its disposition.

rationale: States the conditioning time of frozen packs.

rationale: States the FZ-1 setpoint.

rationale: Limits the exception to one session.
span_text: A second session without a working sampler is not permitted; the line waits until a sampler is repaired, replaced or borrowed from a qualified alternative.

rationale: States the pre-session flow check value and tolerance.
